scientific_integrity: The new part is a fixed-binary lower construction; the universal upper bound is credited to Bals et al. (2026), and cyclic de Bruijn existence is classical. The proof covers every integer length n at least 64. Finite tests corroborate but do not prove the universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: No exact maximum, no optimality of the second-order deficit, no result for n below 64, and no claim concerning typical random texts. An equivalent unindexed fixed-alphabet construction is possible. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Fixed-binary asymptotic sharpness of the frequent-factor bound
